text: In this month we gathered around one occasion. One hundred two of us said "state of the union"; eighty-eight said "state of the union address," both peaking on 2020-02-04. Fifty-four of us said "trump's state of the union," forty-nine said "trump's state of the union address," and forty-three said "president trump's state of the union." The next day, 2020-02-05, forty-six of us said "articles of impeachment" and forty-six said "abuse of power." On 2020-02-13, forty-five of us said "the equal rights amendment." We did not originate these phrases. "trump's state of the union" first appeared 2017-01-17 from Ted Lieu; "trump's state of the union address" 2018-01-26 from Suzanne Bonamici; "president trump's state of the union" 2018-01-29 from Mike Quigley. We report the record as we find it, and the counts of us on each.
